propositions: Three independent detached-child spawn sites (push.py, enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py) duplicate the PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and stdio discipline logic
A defect (missing cwd parameter) propagated across all three sites via deliberate copy-paste imitation rather than being fixed once in a shared implementation

Consolidate all detached rebar child spawning into a single `spawn_detached()` helper in `_proc.py` that owns the bootstrap, detach flags, and cwd logic while preserving caller-supplied env and per-site exception handling

A static test must enforce that the detached spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in `_proc.py` to prevent future copy-paste propagation
gc_trigger.py landed as a fourth copy-paste site during review; spawn_detached must be generalized to support multiple arguments to consolidate it and future detached children
